title: VTA DID-Template Render — payload
description: Render a global DID template to a DID document. Authenticated callers supply variables; the VTA injects ambient variables (VTA_DID, VTA_URL, NOW) server-side, merges the caller's on top, substitutes every placeholder, and returns the rendered document.

name.description: Resource id — the name of the global template to render.

vars.description: Caller-supplied template variables, keyed by name. The VTA injects ambient variables VTA_DID, VTA_URL, NOW server-side and merges these on top.

document.description: The rendered DID document with all placeholders substituted.
